Class_Skill_Desc_Bladeblitz: Delivers an attack with a potency of 600 to all nearby enemies.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Defend: Reduces damage taken by 50%.</br>Duration: 5s</br>Additional Effect: Grants a stack of Finishing Fervor upon taking reduced damage</br>Maximum Stacks: 4</br>Duration: 120s</br>Removes a stack of Finishing Fervor upon taking damage when the action is not on cooldown.
Class_Skill_Desc_Finisher: Delivers an attack to target.</br>20% chance for an attack with a potency of 1,000, the chance increasing by 20% for every stack of Finishing Fervor.</br>Additional Effect: 25% chance to kill target instantly, with some exceptions</br>60% chance for an attack with a potency of 600, the chance decreasing by 15% for every stack of Finishing Fervor.</br>20% chance for your attack to miss, the chance decreasing by 5% for every stack of Finishing Fervor.</br>Potency scales with item level.
Class_Skill_Desc_Long Reach: Delivers an attack with a potency of 400.</br>Potency scales with item level.
